voice-changer.description.source: Change pitch, shape radio or deep-voice effects, preview echo, and export processed audio locally. Free, private, and no upload.
voice-changer.description.translation_input: Change the audio pitch on this device. Add a radio effect or a deep voice effect. Listen to the echo effect. Export the processed audio on this device. This tool is free and private. Audio is never sent to a server.

voice-changer.details.source: Your browser decodes the selected audio, applies Web Audio filters, gain, pitch-rate and optional echo locally, then renders a WAV file for download. No audio is sent to a server.
voice-changer.details.translation_input: This browser decodes the selected audio locally. It uses Web Audio filters. It changes the volume, pitch and playback speed. It can add echo. It creates a WAV file for download. No audio is sent to a server.

shikaku.limits.source: Puzzles are made in your browser. A larger grid can take a moment on a slower device. No account or file upload is needed.
shikaku.limits.translation_input: This browser creates the puzzles. Larger grids can take a moment on slower devices. No account is needed. No file upload is needed.

dxf-viewer.faq.1.a.source: The viewer draws only the entity types listed in its supported-content section. Other entities are reported by type and count; they are not silently approximated.
dxf-viewer.faq.1.a.translation_input: This tool draws only the geometric object types listed under supported content. It lists other geometric objects by type and number. Unsupported objects are not replaced with approximate shapes.

voice-changer.fields.privacy.source: Audio stays in this browser. It is not uploaded or saved by UsefulVerse.
voice-changer.fields.privacy.translation_input: Audio stays in this browser. No audio is sent to or saved by UsefulVerse.

dxf-viewer.description.source: Open ASCII DXF drawings locally. View supported 2D lines, circles, arcs and polylines, toggle layers, measure distances and export the supported geometry as SVG or PNG.
dxf-viewer.description.translation_input: Open ASCII DXF drawings on this device. View supported 2D lines, circles, arcs and polylines. Show or hide layers and measure distances. Export the supported geometry as SVG or PNG.

dxf-viewer.details.source: A local worker parses ASCII DXF. No scripts, external references, images, fonts or network resources in the file are executed or fetched. This viewer does not open DWG or binary DXF.
dxf-viewer.details.translation_input: A background task in this browser reads ASCII DXF. No scripts, external references, images, fonts or network resources in the file are executed or fetched. This tool cannot open DWG or binary DXF.

dxf-viewer.intro.source: Open an ASCII DXF drawing on this device. Pan and zoom, show or hide layers, measure a distance, and export the geometry this viewer supports. The original file is not uploaded.
dxf-viewer.intro.translation_input: Open an ASCII DXF drawing on this device. Move around the drawing and zoom. Show or hide layers and measure distances. Export the geometry supported by this tool. The original file is never sent to a server.

dxf-viewer.privacy.source: The file is read in this browser and is not uploaded. Only basic 2D lines, circles, arcs and straight-segment polylines are drawn; unsupported entities are listed and excluded from measurements and export.
dxf-viewer.privacy.translation_input: This browser reads your file. The file is never sent to a server. This tool only draws basic 2D lines, circles, arcs and polylines with straight segments. Unsupported geometric objects are listed. They are excluded from measurements and export.

dxf-viewer.fields.noLayers.source: No layers are declared; entities use their own layer names.
dxf-viewer.fields.noLayers.translation_input: No layers are declared. Geometric objects use their own layer names.

dxf-viewer.limits.source: Supported preview and export: LINE, CIRCLE, ARC, and straight LWPOLYLINE/POLYLINE in the XY plane. Bulged curves, text, blocks, dimensions, splines, 3D entities and other types are listed as unsupported and are not included in measurements or exports. Maximum file size: 10 MB; maximum group records: 200,000.
dxf-viewer.limits.translation_input: Preview and export support LINE, CIRCLE, ARC and straight LWPOLYLINE/POLYLINE in the XY plane. Curved polyline segments, text, blocks, dimensions, splines, 3D geometric objects and other types are listed as unsupported. They are not included in measurements or exports. Maximum file size: 10 MB. Maximum group records: 200,000.

dxf-viewer.example.source: A line from (0, 0) to (10, 0) measures 10 drawing units. The viewer reads the DXF unit code when present; when it is absent, measurements are labelled as drawing units.
dxf-viewer.example.translation_input: A line from (0, 0) to (10, 0) measures 10 drawing units. This tool reads the DXF unit code when present. Without that code, measurements are labelled as drawing units.

voice-changer.fields.faq4a.source: The tool renders a standard uncompressed WAV file in your browser. The input may be any audio format that your browser can decode.

voice-changer.example.source: Try a voice recording and compare the original with the radio or lower-pitch preset. Pitch changes also change playback speed; this is not voice cloning or studio-grade pitch correction.
voice-changer.example.translation_input: Try a voice recording. Compare the original with the radio effect preset or the lower-pitch preset. Pitch changes also change playback speed. This is not voice cloning or studio-grade pitch correction.

voice-changer.limits.source: This lightweight tool is designed for short clips, not full-length songs. Pitch is changed by adjusting playback rate, so the clip duration and voice tone change together. Effects cannot create a natural new identity, separate voices, or guarantee the same result on every browser.
voice-changer.limits.translation_input: This lightweight tool is designed for short clips, not full-length songs. Pitch changes by adjusting playback speed. Clip duration and voice tone change together. The effects cannot create a natural new identity or isolate voices. They cannot guarantee the same result in every browser.

shikaku.details.source: Choose a start square, then choose an end square to draw a rectangle. You can also drag across the grid. Every rectangle must contain one clue whose number matches its area.
shikaku.details.translation_input: Choose a start square, then choose an end square to draw a rectangle. You can also drag across the grid. Each rectangle must contain exactly one number clue. That number must equal the number of squares inside the rectangle.

shikaku.fields.faq.0.a.source: Shikaku is a number puzzle. Draw rectangles around the clues. Each rectangle has the area shown by its clue, and all grid squares must be used once.

translations.nb-NO: Velg en startrute og deretter en sluttrute for å tegne et rektangel. Du kan også dra over rutenettet. Hvert rektangel må inneholde nøyaktig én tall-ledetråd. Tallet må være lik antallet ruter i rektangelet.

translations.bn: শুরুর বর্গক্ষেত্রটি বেছে নিন, তারপর একটি আয়তক্ষেত্র আঁকার জন্য শেষের বর্গক্ষেত্রটি বেছে নিন। আপনি গ্রিডের ওপর দিয়েও টেনে নিয়ে যেতে পারেন । প্রত্যেকটি আয়তক্ষেত্রের মধ্যে অবশ্যই একটি সংখ্যার ইঙ্গিত থাকতে হবে। এই সংখ্যাটি অবশ্যই আয়তক্ষেত্রের ভেতরে বর্গক্ষেত্রের সংখ্যার সমান হতে হবে ।
translations.ru: Выберите начальный квадрат, затем выберите конечный квадрат, чтобы нарисовать прямоугольник. Вы также можете перетаскивать по сетке. Каждый прямоугольник должен содержать одну подсказку, номер которой соответствует его площади.

translations.ko: 브라우저가 선택한 오디오를 기기에서 디코딩하고 Web Audio 필터, 볼륨과 피치 및 재생 속도 조절, 선택적 에코 효과를 적용합니다. 그런 다음 다운로드할 WAV 파일을 만듭니다. 오디오는 서버로 전송되지 않습니다.
translations.id: Peramban Anda mendekode audio yang dipilih secara lokal. Filter Web Audio mengatur efek audio. Volume, nada dan kecepatan pemutaran dapat diubah. Gema dapat ditambahkan. Audio lalu dirender menjadi berkas WAV untuk diunduh. Tidak ada audio yang dikirim ke server.
translations.zh-CN: 浏览器在本地解码所选音频，应用 Web Audio 滤波器、增益、音高与播放速率调整以及可选回声，然后生成可下载的 WAV 文件。音频不会发送到服务器。
translations.bn: এই ব্রাউজার নির্বাচিত অডিও ডিকোড করে। এটি স্থানীয়ভাবে Web Audio ফিল্টার প্রয়োগ করে এবং অডিওর মাত্রা বদলায়। পিচ ও প্লেব্যাকের হার একসঙ্গে বদলায়; চাইলে প্রতিধ্বনি যোগ করে। ডাউনলোডের জন্য একটি WAV ফাইল তৈরি করে। কোনো অডিও সার্ভারে পাঠানো হয় না।
translations.ru: Браузер декодирует выбранное аудио и обрабатывает его на вашем устройстве. Он применяет фильтры Web Audio, меняет усиление, высоту звука и скорость воспроизведения, а также при необходимости добавляет эхо. Затем он создаёт файл WAV для скачивания. Аудио не отправляется на сервер.
